name: Guard Effect
text:
(Legacy)
Flash
Target one of your White Spirits. During this battle, it can't be targeted by opposing Magic effects.

name: Sacrifice Strike
name_jp: サクリファイスストライク
text:
Flash
Target one of your attacking Spirits with Rumble. Destroy it. Discard a number of cards from the opposing decktop equal to the number specified by its Rumble.

name: Boost Energy
text:
{{Soul Magic|b}}
You can't use this card during Main Step.

Flash
You can target one of your Nexuses. Send one or more cores from your Field/Reserve to it, and during this battle, it doesn't activate its Nexus effects, and is treated as a Spirit with "LV1 5000 BP, LV2 7000 BP." Then, target one of your "Cyantree" family Spirits. During this battle, give it +2000 BP.

name: Furious Anger
name_jp: フューリアスアンガー
text:
Flash
If all your Spirits are Cost 2/4/6/8 with the "Topaz" family, target an opposing Spirit. During this step, it loses one of its symbols. (You choose the symbol)

name: The PurpleAsterBladessom Rindorin
name_jp: 紫苑の刀華リンドリン
text:
[LV1-2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Discard a Spirit card among them. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom in any order. Then, if the discarded card has the "Dark Puce" family, target an opposing Spirit. Send a core from it to the Reserve. (The opponent chooses which cores to send)

[LV2] (True Release) {{Invoke|Main}} (Once Per Turn)
Target a Purple Spirit card in your Trash. During this step, one of its Purple symbols is treated as a Purple EX symbol.

name: ［Rabbit Origin］Misty Lylebit
name_jp: ［卯オリジン］ミスティ・ライルビット
text:
[Teams: Blue Beat/Pretty Animals]

Flash - (Your Attack Step)
If all your Spirits/Nexuses have Blue Beat, and the (Soul Core) is in your Reserve, you can summon this card from the Hand. You can only use this effect of the same card name once per turn.

[LV1-2] (When Summoned)
If you control four or more Blue Beat Spirits, put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

name: Howling Song
text:
[Team: Green Wave]

Main
During this turn, give all your Green Wave Spirits: " (During Attack) When blocked, target an opposing refreshed Spirit. Exhaust it."

name: Diva On Stage
name_jp: ディーバ・オンステージ
text:
{{Soul Magic|y}}
This card has every team, and when using it via Soul Magic, the symbols of all your "Diva" family Spirits/Nexuses are also treated as Yellow.

Main
Reveal four cards from your decktop. Among them, add to your Hand one of each "Diva" family Spirit card and Magic card, each with a card name different from this card's. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom in any order.

Flash
Target one of your Spirits. During this turn, give it +3000 BP.

name: Twilight Fantasia Song
name_jp: トワイライトファンタジアソング
text:
[Team: Yellow Rise]

Flash
Target one of your Yellow Rise Spirits. During this battle, give it: " (During Attack) When this Spirit's attack reduces the opposing Life, if your Life is three or less, put a core from the Void to your Life."
